title: BB-8
subtitle: The Resistance
description: BB-8 was a small round Astromech that belonged to Resistance Pilot Poe Dameron. Following the destruction of Starkiller Base, BB-8 aids Poe in a series of daring maneuvers that cost him his rank. In a desperate bid to find a codebreaker, BB-8 traveled to Canto Bight with Finn and Rose Tico who recruited the questionable DJ. While trying to disable the First Order's hyperspace tracking, the group was caught, but escaped after destroying the ship.
